# YM36: 涵虚朗鉴 Hanxu Langjian, "Vast Empty Clear Mirror"

Wave 2 · Yuanming Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=YM36` · Page: `/scenes/#YM36` · Row: `research/buildings/YM36-hanxu-langjian/`

## What it was

涵虚朗鉴 Hanxu Langjian: in S05 (1774+) it stands on the east shore of 福海 and is the main hall of 雷峰夕照 Leifeng Xizhao, with 惠如春 to the north-west, 寻云榭, 贻兰庭, 会心不远 north, 临众芳, 云锦墅, 菊秀松蔚, 万景天全 south (S05 j82:21a). The note says its plaque 'formerly hung at 澄虚榭 on the west of the lake and was later moved to 雷峰夕照 on the east' (S05 j82:21b). S361 dates the east-shore hall to 1738: three bays facing west, 雷峰夕照 outside, 涵虚朗鉴 inside (E2018). Burned October 1860 (S02 pp.187-188).

From the inventory row: **built** by 1762 (first dated item); 1738; **changed** 1744 poem 結宇福海之西 [j82:21b-22a]; plaque 舊懸湖西澄虛榭 後移置湖東雷峯夕照軒宇 [j82:21b]. The album view predates this move.; plaque 涵虚朗鉴 formerly at 澄虚榭 (west shore), moved to 雷峰夕照 (east shore); the 1744 leaf already says 福海之東, so the move predates 1744; **destroyed** 1860 (S05, S02, S08, S01, S360, S361).

## The scene itself

### The leaf of 1744, its poem and preface

Preface of 1744 as written on the album leaf P0036 (read from the image): "結宇福海之東左右雲隄紆委千章層青面前巨浸空澄一泓淨碧": 'built on the EAST of 福海', cloud-like dykes left and right, the great sheet of water in front; sun and moon rise and set over it. The 日下旧闻考 copy reads 福海之西 here (S05 j82:21b-22a): the album, the earlier and autograph-copy text, says east.

### How later sources differ

S05 (1774+) puts 涵虚朗鉴 on the east shore as the main hall of 雷峰夕照 and says its plaque 'formerly hung at 澄虚榭 on the west of the lake and was later moved' there (S05 j82:21a-b). The 1744 leaf already says 結宇福海之東 (P0036), and S361 dates the east-shore three-bay hall facing west to 1738 (E2018). So the move west to east, if real, happened before 1744, and the leaf shows the east-shore site that stood in 1860; S01 labels 涵虚朗鉴 and 雷峰夕照 there (YM36, YM36-01). S05's 福海之西 in the preface looks like a copying slip or a later edit, to be checked in another edition.

- **Q10. 涵虚朗鉴.** YM36 stands on the east shore of 福海 (雷峰夕照 labelled there, S05). The same four characters are written clearly under B0355 at the 花神庙 group (2593,1993), in the north of Yuan Ming Yuan: row `YM23-N05`. Same name twice, or another plaque? YM36 stays on 福海.
- **Q41. 藏密楼 YM31-07, 松风阁 YM81.** 百景图志 and the site stone put them in 平湖秋月; S337 and S111 put 君子轩-藏密楼 (1758) under 涵虚朗鉴 on the north shore. Two against one. 富春楼 YM02-09: Qianlong's note of 1794 says it stands before 镂月开云 (S360 p.109), the compilation files it under 勤政亲贤.
